## Confidence Movement Log Template

Use this template to maintain a historical record of confidence changes for audit and retrospective purposes. Append one row per dimension change, newest at the bottom.

Decision: <the named decision this log tracks>
Confidence legend: red is Low, amber is Medium, green is High.

| Date       | Dimension        | Previous level       | New level            | Evidence for change | Decision enabled                          |
|------------|------------------|----------------------|----------------------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| YYYY-MM-DD | Dimension name   | Low / Medium / High  | Low / Medium / High  | What changed        | What decision this movement supports       |

Record both upward and downward movement. A dimension that shows no movement beyond its declared refresh trigger or expected learning cadence is a stall signal and should trigger a review of the approach for that dimension.
